title: Forever Add-on Catalog: checked releases
description: versions.json, written by the catalog's release check: the latest checked release of each add-on for each edition, so the app finds updates without asking GitHub. Rules the schema can't express are checked by scripts/validate.cs.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

schemaVersion.description: The format version. The app refuses a file whose schemaVersion it doesn't know.

checked.description: When the run that last changed this file finished, in UTC (2026-11-26T04:00:00Z). A run that finds nothing new leaves the file as it is, so its ETag stays valid.

addons.description: Keyed by the add-on's catalog ID, then by edition ID.

release.description: The latest checked release for one edition. One file for several editions is listed under each of them; a release with one file per edition lists each edition's own file.
The release as the source names it: a GitHub tag.

size.description: The file's size in bytes, as GitHub lists it.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256, lowercase hex. The app refuses a download that doesn't match.

interface.description: The Interface the file's .toc lists for this edition.

upToDate.description: Whether that's the edition's current Interface. False for a release that isn't updated yet (it lists the previous patch's, or a PTR's live edition's).

folders.description: The folders this edition installs, when the release check left some of the release's folders out: folders whose .toc lists only other editions' Interfaces (Deadly Boss Mods' Retail-only modules, in a zip made for every edition). Left out, it's all of them.

published.description: The day the release was published (YYYY-MM-DD).
